::: {.about-location}

::: {.about-bio}
I am an experienced **Deep Learning Engineer** with a focus on **Computer Vision**. My research interests lie in Vision-Language Models (VLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and Agentic AI systems. I'm passionate about building intelligent, scalable solutions that bridge the gap between cutting-edge research and practical applications.
